# HumanPush

> In test. No real orders or payments run yet. An AI agent orders the work and the signature of a professional listed in a public Dutch register, through one MCP. The company pays 100% upfront. Fixed rules, the same for every profession. Every step is signed and logged, and the proof can be checked independently.

People use https://humanpush.nl. This file is for agents and lives at https://humanpush.nl/llms.txt.

## Status

- Protocol v1 is in test. There is no public v1 endpoint yet. Access opens after the test phase is completed; there is no start date.
- Companies only (B2B, with a Dutch KvK number). Netherlands first.
- All amounts and time limits are test values or working rules during the test phase.
- HumanPush is a trade name of HumAgent B.V., KvK 42222476.

## The model

Company -> its AI agent -> HumanPush MCP -> a registered professional (with his own agent or assistant, signing on the HumanPush signing page with his passkey) -> back to the company with the signed result and the proof.

The protocol runs the terms; the log is the proof. If the terms, the protocol and this file differ, the terms come first, then the protocol, then this file. No helpdesk, no exceptions: v1_explain explains every state, reason and error code.

## The five services

One service per register. HumanPush is not part of any register and uses no register logos.

- NIVRE (claims adjusters): an independent opinion on a claims decision, on the documents. Disclaimer: an opinion on documents only, no inspection on site; no personal injury. Register proof valid 30 days.
- NRVT (registered valuers, Kamer Wonen): a valuation report of a home, without NWWI validation. Disclaimer: not for a mortgage or NHG. Register proof valid 30 days.
- NRGD (court experts, 008.4 multimedia): an authenticity examination of an image or video file. Disclaimer: outside court proceedings; not a court expert report. Register proof valid 30 days.
- Register of patent attorneys (Octrooicentrum Nederland): a novelty quick scan. Disclaimer: no filing, no freedom-to-operate advice; the company is visible to the professional for the conflict check; the content only after acceptance. Register proof: the list's reference date at most 120 days old.
- NRBI (Nederlands Register Bouwkundig Inspecteurs): a remote review of an existing building inspection report. Disclaimer: no new inspection and no NRBI-validated inspection. Register proof valid 30 days.

list_services gives per service the exact service_id, inputs, outcomes, price range, the fixed HumanPush fee H, the review criteria, the disclaimer and the known gaps of the register.

## When not to use HumanPush

- For consumers.
- When you do not need a registered signer.
- For a valuation for a mortgage, court expert reports, patent filings or notarial deeds.
- To force a different conclusion: a dispute is only about form and whether the question was answered.

## Tools, in order

Tool names as on the v1 test branch; they may change. Every write call takes an idempotency_key: the same key never runs an action twice.

1. list_services: the bookable services and the terms of the one method.
2. v1_create_order: service_id, inputs, deadline (ISO 8601) and max_price_cents. Optional: min_proof_level, to require a higher register proof (never below 2). You never name a professional; unknown fields are refused. Returns pay_url.
3. Pay pay_url within 30 minutes: max_price_cents plus H. Not paid in time: the order lapses, nobody pays anything.
4. v1_get_status: state, reason, every deadline and the money. Expired clocks are processed first. Poll it.
5. v1_get_result: the delivered piece, its SHA-256 and the professional's registration number.
6. verify_proof: checks the hash, the professional's passkey signature and the signed log.
7. v1_accept_result, or v1_object within 72 hours with grounds taken from the service's review criteria (otherwise invalid_objection).
8. v1_cancel: possible until delivery.
9. v1_explain: the fixed explanation of any state, reason or error code.

Professionals use v1_professional_status and v1_professional_act; every action of a professional is signed with his passkey.

## States

- offered: ordered, waiting for payment (30 minutes).
- funded: paid. The protocol offers the order in turns to at most 3 matching professionals from a fixed queue; together they have 4 working hours.
- active: accepted. The difference with his lower price went back. The delivery deadline runs.
- delivered: 72 hours to accept or dispute. Silence counts as acceptance.
- review: disputed. A reviewer from the same register, matched by the protocol, decides meets or fails.
- hold_2a: the 72 hours ended while HumanPush could not show its service worked. A dispute is still possible for a limited time; payout moves at most 5 working days.
- closed_success, closed_refund (with a reason), closed_cancelled, expired.

Reasons include no_accept, cancelled, withdrawn, late, review_fails, returned_conflict, suspended, deregistered, no_reviewer, platform and success. Ask v1_explain for each.

## Money

- 100% upfront: max_price_cents plus the fixed HumanPush fee H (price on request).
- When the professional accepts at his own lower price, the difference goes back at once.
- Nobody accepts within the turns: everything back.
- Cancel before acceptance: everything back. After acceptance and before delivery: the professional keeps 25% of his fee, the rest goes back, including H. No cancelling after delivery.
- The professional withdraws or delivers late: everything back. No replacement and no extension after acceptance; you may order again.
- Conflict of interest, only for a service with a mandatory conflict check (now patent attorneys): the professional returns the order before delivery; everything back, no 25%.
- The register reports the professional as suspended or deregistered before delivery: everything back; he is not paid.
- Dispute: only on the review criteria (form complete, question answered). The verdict is binary: meets, or fails with a ground. Fails: everything back. There is no second round and no partial outcome.
- No reviewer found, or HumanPush cannot show its own service worked: everything back, and HumanPush pays the professional from its own reserve.
- The professional is paid after acceptance, after 72 hours without a dispute, or after meets. HumanPush keeps H only when an order succeeds.

## Proof

- Register proof, level 2 at least: a person looked the professional up in the public register with a fixed checklist; source, time and a hash are kept. Valid 30 days, 120 days for patent attorneys. Checked again at every acceptance (for NRVT by hand, logged). It is a register attestation with a validity period, not a live link to the register. Without a stored attestation a professional gets no turn.
- A company may require a higher level (min_proof_level), never a lower one. At the start no register offers a higher level, so a higher requirement finds nobody now.
- Every step of a professional or reviewer is signed with his passkey.
- The log is signed and every event refers to the previous one. An export of an order can be checked by anyone.
